title: Para Bellum content: Industrial Capacity claims
description: What bids for a nation's Industrial Capacity. File: Content/<namespace>/claim.json. A claim set is data, not an enum (AD-M36): a mod adds a claim by adding a row. An equipment class names the claim that builds it (class.json claim), so a production claim with no class pointing at it is declared and idle, and lights up the day a class does. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md in the game repository.

role.description: What the engine does with this claim's share (vocabulary.json claim_roles). The code cannot branch on an opaque id, so this is the one thing it reads. Exactly one civilian and one construction claim exist.

domains.description: The research catalogue's DESIGN domains this claim pays for, spelled as research.json spells them. The game never reads this: the pipeline's gate uses it to check that every design domain has one claim, and that a class's claim agrees with its designs' domain.
